wire.t: Week 9 is final. Catfan94’s Farm Team (jrsmith1391) put up 180.30 to beat Jefferson’s Reserve 82.92, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat The Champ 164.84 to 127.74, Hold My DK beat Bourbon Lover 147.12 to 86.20, Kraft for Cash beat I Chase Brown Kids 121.74 to 99.86, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte beat OBJAY 115.16 to 108.88, and Asian Jim beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 86.00 to 68.34.

Week 10 byes are Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay. Catfan94’s Farm Team has four starters on those teams (Swift, Irving, Loveland and Mayfield), and OBJAY has three (Nix, Egbuka and Burden III).
Carson Wentz started Monday night for Minnesota with Kyler Murray sidelined. Br0phy started Wentz for Dude, Your Getting a Dell and got -2.76. ManicOrientals owns Murray on Asian Jim.
C.J. Stroud scored 50.36 on Jefferson’s Reserve’s bench in Week 9, and Kayshon Boutte had 29.5 on The Champ’s bench. Both teams lost.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix (Catfan94) and Hold My DK (TheMoneyTeam2302) are both 8‑1. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has won five in a row and leads the league with 1482.14 points and an 84-15 all-play record.
Dude, Your Getting a Dell (Br0phy) is 0‑9. Three starters scored below zero in Week 9: Joe Fagnano (-0.3), a Raiders running back at -0.3 and Wentz (-2.76).
Nothing new on the trade wire since Friday's three deals. The last moves were paknight12 dropping Kendre Miller and Raheim Sanders on Saturday and TheMoneyTeam2302 dropping Mack Hollins on Sunday.

stories.title: Week 9 recap: Catfan94’s Farm Team drops 180.30, The Champ loses with the highest losing score, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑9
stories.dek: A 97.38-point blowout, a 6.28-point nail-biter and three starters below zero.
body: Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Jefferson’s Reserve 180.30 to 82.92, a 97.38-point margin and the biggest of the week. Kenneth Walker III had 36.8, Brock Purdy 31.28, Christian Watson 28.6 and Bucky Irving 27.5. jrsmith1391 is 6‑3 and has won two straight.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat The Champ 164.84 to 127.74. Jordan Love scored 42.18, Ja'Marr Chase 30.0 and Brock Bowers 24.3, and Catfan94 is 8‑1 with five wins in a row. TJohn91 had the highest losing score of the week and still lost by 37.10. Josh Jacobs scored -0.5 in the lineup, and Boutte (29.5) and Matthew Stafford (13.22) sat on the bench.

Hold My DK beat Bourbon Lover 147.12 to 86.20 behind Puka Nacua at 32.5 and Christian McCaffrey at 23.7. Kraft for Cash beat I Chase Brown Kids 121.74 to 99.86, and Asian Jim beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 86.00 to 68.34, which is the lowest score of the week. Br0phy is 0‑9.

StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte beat OBJAY 115.16 to 108.88 by 6.28, the closest game of the week. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑6 with Drake Maye at 24.76. JAY2913 had Efton Chism III on the bench with 14.4, and swapping him in for Emeka Egbuka (6.4) would have won it 116.88 to 115.16.

stories.title: Stroud 50.36, Boutte 29.5, Chism III 14.4: three benches that cost real points
stories.dek: Jefferson’s Reserve, The Champ and OBJAY all had a better player sitting than starting.
body: C.J. Stroud had 50.36 on the bench for Jefferson’s Reserve. That's more than any starter on any team scored this week, and Kirk Cousins at 13.64 was in the lineup instead. It wouldn't have saved a 97.38-point loss, but it's a lot of points to leave on a bench.

Kayshon Boutte had 29.5 on The Champ’s bench and Matthew Stafford had 13.22. Swapping both in for Keenan Allen (5.6) and Jared Goff (5.8) gets TJohn91 to 159.06, which still loses to 164.84. Josh Jacobs at -0.5 is the line that hurts.

OBJAY is the one that could have been fixed. Efton Chism III had 14.4 on the bench, Emeka Egbuka had 6.4 in the lineup, and the game finished 115.16 to 108.88. JAY2913 is 4‑5 and is 6.28 points from 5‑4.

stories.title: Bye week hits Catfan94’s Farm Team and OBJAY hardest, and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is a 40.4-point favorite
stories.dek: Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay are off, and the lines already know.
body: Four teams are on bye in Week 10: Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay. Catfan94’s Farm Team has Swift, Irving, Loveland and Mayfield in its lineup on those teams, which is four starters out against OBJAY, who is missing Nix, Egbuka and Burden III. The line is Catfan94’s Farm Team by 22.6.

The biggest spread is The Champ by 64.1 over Dude, Your Getting a Dell, whose Goedert is off. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is a 40.4-point favorite over Jefferson’s Reserve, and Hold My DK is a 41.2-point favorite over StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte, where Bill_Buttlicker has Jalen Hurts on IR and Philadelphia’s receivers on bye.
The closest game on the board is Kraft for Cash by 12.5 over Asian Jim. I Chase Brown Kids is favored over Bourbon Lover by 19.7, with Courtland Sutton on bye for paknight12.

stories.title: Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks, and four contenders own none
stories.dek: The picks through 2029 are lopsided, and the standings are too.
body: Counting 2027 through 2029, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte owns 12 first-round picks, which is a full first round's worth of picks. JAY2913 is next with six on OBJAY, then ZachCarroll09 with five on I Chase Brown Kids and Br0phy with four on Dude, Your Getting a Dell.

Kraft for Cash, Catfan94’s Farm Team, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK own zero first-round picks over that stretch, and they are the top four teams in the standings. That's a bet on now, and it's working while the whole group is 6‑3 or better.
The risk is that all four teams are on the wrong side of a rebuild in three years, and the one with 12 first-round picks is 3‑6 with 27-72 all-play. Tyler's plan is a long one.

rumors.t: Hugh G. Rection reportedly requested a 97.38-point blowout be stopped at halftime, and Sleeper said it doesn't have a mercy rule. He yelled at the scoreboard anyway.
Josh Jacobs reportedly demanded to be paid 0.5 points to make up the difference. TJohn91 said he'd take it under advisement.
C.J. Stroud has reportedly asked jmello16 for a one-on-one meeting, the agenda being a single slide that says 50.36.
Bill_Buttlicker reportedly celebrated a 6.28-point win by texting himself congratulations, and then replied to himself with a thumbs-up.
Br0phy has reportedly submitted a proposal to the league to have starters scoring below zero count as a bye week. The league is reviewing the proposal in the same pile as everything else.
Efton Chism III has reportedly started a petition to be counted as the 6.4 in OBJAY's lineup. JAY2913 says he'll look at it next week.
TheMoneyTeam2302 is reportedly telling people Darren Waller's 25.0 on the bench was a strategic decision. Nobody has asked.
Holden McGroin reportedly has a plan for the four teams on bye next week, and it's to start them anyway.

columnists.name: Hugh G. Rection
columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from a basement shrine to Boston sports in pajama pants, fueled by Dunkin'. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columnists.bio: Press-box regular with a pocket square and a former linebacker's bedside manner. Blunt, polished, and always one sentence away from calling you soft.

columnists.name: Holden McGroin
columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league once. Nobody knows how. Files his columns from the porch of a trailer with a laptop he calls 'the press credential' and gives advice anyway.

columnists.bio: Covers the league from the sideline with a media pass and a spreadsheet for everything. None of her spreadsheets are correct, and she will defend every one of them.

KAYSHON BOUTTE HAD 29.5 ON THE BENCH! MATTHEW STAFFORD HAD 13.22 ON THE BENCH! AND TJOHN91 STILL LOST! THAT'S WHAT 164.84 WILL DO TO YOU!
AND DUDE, YOUR GETTING A DELL IS 0‑9! THREE STARTERS BELOW ZERO! I'VE SEEN BASEMENTS WITH MORE FLOOR!

columns.title: OBJAY lost by 6.28 and the answer was on the bench
columns.dek: Efton Chism III had 14.4, Emeka Egbuka had 6.4.
body: JAY2913 lost 115.16 to 108.88. Efton Chism III had 14.4 on the bench and Emeka Egbuka had 6.4 in the lineup. That's an 8.0-point swing, and the game was a 6.28-point gap.
That's not bad luck. That's a lineup decision. You are 4‑5 now. You can be 5‑4.
Now it's a bye week and Nix, Egbuka and Burden III are all off. Check the lineup Saturday, JAY2913. Then check it again.

columns.title: 3 tips for bye week, from Holden McGroin, who once started a guy on bye and called it 'load management'
columns.dek: Four teams are off, and so is Holden's will to look at the lineup.
body: 1. Check who's on bye. Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay are off. Catfan94’s Farm Team has four starters on those teams, and you have to look at your lineup to know that.
2. If your starter is on bye, start the bench guy. Efton Chism III had 14.4 on OBJAY's bench and Egbuka had 6.4 in the lineup. Pick the 14.4.
3. Never start a player on bye because he's 'due.' Josh Jacobs had -0.5 last week, and he wasn't on bye. Imagine if he was.

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker is 6.1% lucky
columns.dek: 3‑6 is 33.3% of wins, 27-72 is 27.3%, and I have a spreadsheet.
body: StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte is 3‑6, which is 33.3% wins. In all-play the team is 27-72, which is 27.3% wins. The difference is 6.1 percentage points, and that's how lucky Bill_Buttlicker is.
Catfan94’s Farm Team scored 180.30, and its season PPG is 149.90. That's 30.4 above average, which my model says is the exact amount of 'above.'
Dude, Your Getting a Dell scored 68.34 against a season PPG of 79.64. That's 11.3 below average. My model says Br0phy is trending upward at the rate of a team that has already hit the floor.
